title: Member Charges Signed to the Resort Club Memberships Account
content:
Members of Resort Club Memberships sign outlet purchases to the club account at the member price, which is the outlet's list price less the level's discount for the charge category, rounded to the cent.

## The discount for each charge category

| Charge category | Discount applied | Price the discount is taken from |
|---|---|---|
| Spa treatment | The level's spa treatment discount | The outlet's list price |
| Food and beverage | The level's food and beverage discount | The outlet's list price |
| Shop purchase (retail) | The level's retail discount | The outlet's list price |
| Cabana | The level's cabana discount | The level's cabana day rate |
| Personal training | The level's personal training discount | The level's price of a one-hour personal training session |

The member price is the list price less the discount percent of that list price, and the result is rounded to the cent. The amount on the club account entry is the member price; the entry also shows the outlet's list price before the member discount and the outlet check number.

## Complimentary cabana days

The first complimentary cabana days of a membership year, up to the level's number of complimentary cabana days per membership year, are charged at 0.00. The days already used are counted as the membership's cabana charges at 0.00 in the current membership year.

## Facilities and status

- Facilities outside the level's access — among the fitness centre, the resort pools, the spa thermal facilities and the beach club — cannot be used or charged.
- Member charges are accepted only while the membership's status is active or notice given. A membership that is pending, frozen or terminated accepts no member charges.

## Limits of the member discount

Discounts never combine with other offers or apply to hotel room charges.

## Worked prices (hypothetical inputs)

| Purchase | Discount | Working | Member price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Restaurant check, list price 84.50 | 10% | 10% of 84.50 is 8.45; 84.50 less 8.45 | 76.05 |
| Shop purchase, list price 37.85 | 15% | 15% of 37.85 is 5.6775; 37.85 less 5.6775 is 32.1725, rounded to the cent | 32.17 |
| Cabana day, day rate 250.00, complimentary days used up | 25% | 25% of 250.00 is 62.50; 250.00 less 62.50 | 187.50 |
| Personal training, session price 95.00 | 15% | 15% of 95.00 is 14.25; 95.00 less 14.25 | 80.75 |

## Complimentary cabana days counted (hypothetical)

At a level with 2 complimentary cabana days per membership year:

| Cabana charges at 0.00 already in the current membership year | The next cabana day is charged |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 0.00 |
| 2 | At the member price |
